title: Subscription
description: Recurring subscription plan for a user or customer. Tracks subscription details, pricing, billing cycle, status, renewal settings, and trial period information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the subscription record

user_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user or customer who owns this subscription

plan.description: Subscription plan name or tier (e.g., Basic, Pro, Enterprise, Premium)

status.description: Current subscription status (e.g., active, cancelled, expired, suspended, trial)

price.description: Recurring subscription price per billing cycle

currency.description: ISO currency code for the subscription price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

billing_cycle.description: Frequency of billing (e.g., monthly, quarterly, annually, weekly)

start_date.description: Date when the subscription became active

end_date.description: Date when the subscription expires or is scheduled to end

next_billing_date.description: Date of the next scheduled billing or renewal charge

auto_renew.description: Whether the subscription automatically renews at the end of the billing cycle

trial_ends_at.description: Date when a trial period ends and regular billing begins, if applicable
